findings.title: CWE-200 Continuity demos upload private local kit data
findings.suggested_fix: Isolate continuity's authorized embedded demo in fresh in-memory state/storage, following the team-lab pattern. Capture explicitly nonsensitive output instead of the whole #kit. Verify seeded private storage stays unchanged and demoSave contains no saved roster URL or letter/contact markers. This behavior is inherited unchanged from c187604.

testing_gaps: The Studio validation-repair test (harness/tests/studio-backend.test.mjs:399) calls handleStudio with a mock fetch directly. Add an invalid-first, valid-repair case through the authenticated /api/studio job wrapper to exercise its accumulated 128000 budget and cancellation signal.

findings.title: Studio repair lacks a cancellation regression test
findings.suggested_fix: Test cancellation during the second provider call and assert that work stops without returning an activity. Propagate the job signal through repair and customer-review calls.

findings.title: Emergency folder lacks on-screen editing
findings.suggested_fix: Wrap generated emergency content in SBE_DOC.editable, preserve edits across pane rebuilds, and print the edited pane.

findings.title: Continuity sources appear before document end
findings.suggested_fix: Collect selected references from both folders and append one deduplicated source section after the final pane in the print copy.

findings.title: Hyrum's Law: source opt-out invalidates exported v1 activity
findings.suggested_fix: Give the redacted JSON export an explicit versioned public-pack contract with a sourcesOmitted discriminator, and validate it separately from a complete activity.

findings.title: Studio repair ignores cancellation after its request starts
findings.suggested_fix: Link ask() to both the job signal and its 180-second timeout. Verify cancellation during an in-flight repair.

findings.title: Studio repair can outlast the browser's job wait
findings.suggested_fix: Apply a shared end-to-end deadline to all provider calls, or extend polling beyond their maximum sequence and preserve the job ID for resumption.

findings.title: Cancelling a validation repair leaves paid generation running
findings.suggested_fix: Combine the incoming job signal with the repair timeout, reject before submission when cancelled, and propagate cancellation. Verify cancellation during a pending validation repair through createPracticeServer.

findings.title: Validation repair omits the provider output budget cap
findings.suggested_fix: Set explicit max_output_tokens for every repair/review request and validate actual provider usage against the Studio job budget. Exercise over-budget repair usage through the production server wrapper.

findings.title: Continuity demo uploads device-only sensitive input
findings.suggested_fix: Use empty in-memory continuity state for authorized embedded demos; collect input only from #form and exclude .sens nodes. Verify seeded private storage remains unchanged and sensitive sentinels never reach demoSave. Identical defect exists at c187604 with provenance recorded in adversarial.json.
